habitat_note: Only the historical mapped-hard-substrate footprint is used. Its older merged-bathymetry depth mask limits coverage but does not qualify depths; original BAG native cells independently qualify every retained footprint. No pixel or roughness is relabeled as a boulder.

sources.name: NOAA H13093: Vicinity of Anacapa Island
sources.provider: NOAA/NOS Office of Coast Survey; NCEI archive
sources.tidal_epoch: 1983–2001 per final Tide Note in the descriptive report
sources.rights: CC0-1.0, explicit dataset-specific NOAA waiver; not a standalone navigational product
sources.credit: NOAA Ship Rainier; NOAA/NOS Pacific Hydrographic Branch; NOAA NCEI
sources.limitations: Historical 2017 survey, not live bathymetry. Variable 1–16 m cells, with only 1–4 m cells eligible here. The survey report identifies dynamic swirling ridges southwest of West Anacapa; terrain relief does not establish bedrock, individual boulders or current catch abundance. The older substrate interpretation is not ground truth. Source product uncertainty is retained without assigning an unsupported confidence interval.
